title: Affine etale cohomological dimension is bounded by dimension plus the field cohomological dimension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Noether normalization alone does not give the desired bound: the proof needs local strict-henselian estimates indexed by residue transcendence degree. Two support estimates control the boundary of a partial compactification, and a careful two-stage Leray analysis bounds every diagonal of the spectral sequence.
